applicability.jurisdiction_or_standard_context: SteelConstruction.info bracing guidance includes bridge and building examples; portal-frame claims are UK/Eurocode-oriented.

claims.text: Bracing can control buckling, distribute load effects, and provide dimensional control, depending on the system and connection details.
In portal-frame buildings, vertical bracing commonly transfers longitudinal horizontal actions to the ground and provides a stable framework for side rails and cladding.
A bracing card should preserve whether a brace is intended for member restraint, global stability, construction stability, load transfer, or more than one of those functions.

limitations: General bracing principles do not prove that a particular brace is strong, stiff, connected, or correctly placed.
Seismic bracing systems and bridge bracing have additional source-specific requirements not covered here.

pages_used: Bracing systems: What does bracing do?

summary: Bracing knowledge should describe the job a brace is doing before it is treated as a restraint, load path, or global stability component.
title: Steel Bracing Principles
